role: frozen confirmation candidate; not yet approved for delivery or as the formal project baseline

positive: It is the last checkpoint before the clearly visible rise in the 5x dark-edge warning at epoch 50.
It increases median fine-detail energy at 5x, 20x and 50x to 1.066, 1.445 and 1.270 times Raw on the fixed real frames.
Across all 36 SEM pillars and 12 exposures, median IoU is 0.960665 and median boundary distance is 0.423864 percent of pitch, both slightly better than R61v16.
known_risk: Exposure 18 remains a severe failure: median SEM IoU 0.815145 and boundary distance 2.578661 percent of pitch.
The optical midpoint moves outward by 3 pixels at exposure 18, independently supporting a real edge-position shift rather than only an ACM artifact.
This checkpoint cannot be called universally exposure-safe unless confirmation or a later model resolves this failure.
selection_reason.why_not_epoch50_or55: Epoch 50 begins the 5x dark-edge regression; epoch 55 worsens it across magnifications and also has poorer overall and worst-exposure SEM results.
selection_reason.why_not_epoch30_orEarlier: Earlier checkpoints preserve exposure 18 better, but epoch 30 has essentially no 50x fine-detail gain and epochs 20 to 25 are too close to identity for an enhancement delivery.

confirmation_arms.real_sequences: All 301 frames from the six locked 5x, 20x and 50x motion sequences.
confirmation_arms.motion_policy: Reuse the fixed Raw-selected tiles, frame pairs and timing exclusions without model-output-based filtering.
confirmation_arms.tile_policy: Compare full-canvas reference against core sizes 256, 384 and 512 with halo 192 on 5x and 50x images.
confirmation_arms.onnx_policy: Only perform a technical export/parity test after real-motion and tile confirmation. A delivery ZIP is allowed only if scientific risks are acceptable.

delivery_fallback: MOSR_R61_ONNX remains the validated emergency package until this candidate passes or a later scratch model resolves the exposure failure.
